name: Default
shortDescription: Browser-based desktop publishing and page layout studio built in Rust and WebAssembly: spreads, parent pages, threaded text, styles, tables, IDML import and export, and PDF, EPUB and PNG export.

alerts.message: Documents are not stored on the server: the web app runs in the browser and keeps only preferences there. Save or export your layouts to your own device before closing the tab.
The upstream project publishes no container image; this one is built by a community maintainer from the official releases.
